verdict.rationale: monday.com's own integrations directory documents a native Slack integration and a GitHub integration that links pull requests to items, and it claims 850+ integrations and apps overall. Google Drive is never named, though Gmail and Google Calendar are, so only two of the three tools in the story are evidenced, and all of it is marketing copy. Missing for 10: documented Google Drive integration, depth of the Slack/GitHub integration features, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can connect common tools like Slack, GitHub, and Google Drive natively

citations.quote: Link pull requests from GitHub or GitLab directly to their related items in monday.com so teams can quickly access code and updates in context.
